name: paperhub
description: PaperHub 一键启动：npm run dev 起前端，npm run server 起后端 + 分析 Worker

scripts.server: concurrently -k -n backend,worker -c cyan,green "cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000" "cd backend && uv run arq app.workers.main.WorkerSettings"
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.worker: cd backend && uv run arq app.workers.main.WorkerSettings
scripts.mcp: cd mcp-server && uv run python server.py
